# Arslan AWS Lab

> Arslan AWS Lab is Arslan's first AWS project. It demonstrates a secure, automatic static website deployment from GitHub to Amazon S3 and CloudFront.

## Key facts

- Author: Arslan
- Source: https://github.com/arsalanakhtar07-cloud/arslanawslab
- Hosting: private Amazon S3 bucket behind Amazon CloudFront
- Deployment: GitHub Actions with AWS OIDC short-lived credentials
- Public site: __SITE_URL__/

## How deployment works

1. A change is pushed to the main branch on GitHub.
2. GitHub Actions builds the static website.
3. OIDC provides temporary, limited AWS access.
4. Website files are synchronized to the private S3 bucket.
5. CloudFront cache is invalidated and visitors receive the latest version over HTTPS.
